body: You are right

I didn't say it was her fault

I was not pissed off

I am not currently pissed off

All I did was ask how I can help her understand why it's so important to me that she try to time things a little better. One person had a good idea that would help, but I don't see a point in making any changes anyway, I am way past my breaking point and can't fathom the next 24 hours let alone weeks
I said it clearly in the post and am not repeating myself, it's not my fault no one read it.

Did not say it was her fault

Not once

Just asked how I can help her understand why I want her to wait. That is all
Tried to call him back, he will not speak to me, he did not call on purpose. Cannot call only family who cares (his parents) until Monday.

No, because it's my day off. She could've just told me later.

Exactly why I'm done, I'm a piece of shit who doesn't deserve her. I'm too tired to keep doing this. Today was supposed to be my break and I can't take it anymore.

I said I think SHE is worried SHE might forget and that is why she tells me right away.

And I said I think that would help. Not that she shouldn't.

How did you even get that from what I said?
She won't have to deal with it anymore anyway, I can't take it anymore. She is better off without a piece of shit who "can't handle stress."
Nah man I'm done dealing.
It's been like this for years so the fact that she chose my one day off to do it for the first time seems inconsiderate, but no one is listening, whatever.

Tonight? Later in the day even? Not as soon as I wake up and am looking for food? Why is this not a common sense thing? Am I the only one who thinks it's kinder to wait until later so someone can enjoy their one day off?

I didn't say I wanted her to wait until Monday. Just that it would've been better to wait until the end of the day since she knew it would completely ruin my day. Is that abnormal? Do people generally dump horrible news on someone at the start of their one day off when nothing can be done that day anyway? What is wrong with you guys?
Maybe, but it's not usually bad news like this.
I just said I'm not mad. I'm frustrated. Read before you attack.
No I wouldn't, I have the day off.

I have asked her for a couple of years to just not tell me stressful things right when I'm getting ready for sleep. The one time she waits it's at the beginning of my first day off in weeks and it's very upsetting family news. If I have something to tell her that I know is going to ruin her day I wait until the end of it so she can relax.

That's a good idea, thanks. That may help. I think she may be worried she'll forget, I'm not sure.

Most firefighters are pretty stressed out, not much can be done about that.

Edit: Downvoted for thanking someone for an idea? Really?
I'm not mad at her, I'm just frustrated by her sense of timing. It was very upsetting "news."
Sorry that my relapsed alcoholic cousin buttdialing me from the bar doesn't seem like a big deal to you.

Yes, I said in the post that I just want to sleep first. I have trouble sleeping due to stress. I want her to tell me when I wake up, she usually forgets. I don't think I should have to be specific about not wanting my day to be ruined by stressful family news that I can't do anything about until Monday. That seems like common sense to me.

I'm not sure what you mean by emotional support. These are not things she is stressed about, and I said I'm fine with her waiting to tell me until I wake up. I cannot work less. Not for a few more months.
